audience: Codex plugin authors and operators evaluating dual App/MCP auth behavior
candidate_text: Codex PR #27461 makes plugin MCP loading auth-aware: ChatGPT/SIWC auth suppresses same-name App-route MCP OAuth, while API-key/direct auth keeps MCP servers visible. https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27461

claims.text: Codex filters same-name plugin MCP servers for ChatGPT/SIWC auth when a plugin App route exists.
API-key/direct auth preserves plugin MCP server visibility and OAuth behavior.
The app-server install path passes auth mode into the plugin MCP loader before MCP OAuth startup.

decision.reason: The source-backed auth-routing behavior has concrete value for dual App/MCP plugin authors.

evidence_notes: PR #27461 says plugin MCP loading should reflect the MCPs available for the current auth route.
The source review records the loader and app-server install path that enforce same-name filtering.
The impact artifact classifies this as a Control Plane compatibility risk with a practical public angle.
